_comment: Canonical subject-level 4-fold cross-validation split used to TRAIN the paper's models. Reproduces the published cross-fold numbers (verified). Recovered from 2D_workspace create_subject_split.py logic (sorted subjects, no shuffle, np.array_split into 4) and confirmed empirically against the trained models (held-out lesion Dice). The unit is the SUBJECT (spinal cord); materialize per-dataset case-level splits with helpers/make_splits.py using that dataset's inference_manifest.json.
